E0145

`#Persist` on a binding that isn't module-level (D-PERSIST1)

What

`#Persist` on a binding that isn't module-level (D-PERSIST1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0145

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0145: tests/ui/persist_not_module_level.stderr.

Error [E0145]: only module-level state can persist across reloads
  --> tests/ui/persist_not_module_level.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     #Persist counter :: 0
    |     ^^^^^^^^
 Why: persistence is keyed by module + name; a local has no stable identity across a reload
 Fix: move it to module level, or drop `#Persist`
